original_high_level_goal.name: HLG_001
original_high_level_goal.description: Citizens should be able to submit reports by selecting a location on the map and filling out a problem form with necessary details.

branch_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable citizens to effectively report urban issues to municipal authorities.
branch_001.rationale: Grounding: The documentation describes citizens registering, selecting a map point, and completing a mandatory form to submit reports, matching the parent HLG. It also states the system enables citizen participation in reporting urban issues, aligning with the reconstructed HLG. Alignment: Both HLGs target citizens and aim to let them report urban problems, preserving the WHY-level objective of enabling citizen reporting. The reconstructed HLG abstracts the specific map‑selection and form steps but retains the core functional intention.

original_high_level_goal.name: Review and manage citizen reports effectively throughout their lifecycle to ensure timely responses and resolutions.
original_high_level_goal.description: The stakeholder aims to have a comprehensive tool that allows them to review, approve, assign, and monitor citizen reports efficiently.

original_high_level_goal.description: This goal focuses on providing external maintenance personnel with the necessary tools to log in, view, and modify report statuses, as well as exchange comments for effective issue resolution.

original_high_level_goal.description: The stakeholder aims to streamline the management of report handling through the setup of automated processes and oversight capabilities.
